chapters.title: Three structural flaws: duplication, scattered logic, bolted-on security
Three pillars: entity mapping, logic delegation, security as architecture
Thinking like an architect and skill development paths
Patterns that scale: master data, outbox, saga, reference data
Case studies and the ROI of relational design
The 90-day roadmap and a center of excellence

takeaways: Most Dataverse problems are architecture problems: duplicated tables, scattered logic and bolted-on security break systems as they scale.
Validation and calculation logic belongs server-side in Dataverse, while Power Automate should handle notifications, orchestration and integration.
Patterns such as a master data model, the transactional outbox, the saga pattern and canonical reference tables make Dataverse solutions consistent and reliable at enterprise scale.
hook: Your Dataverse environment works for a hundred users, then falls apart at a thousand. This episode is for Power Platform makers and architects who want to move from building apps to designing systems, using entity mapping, logic delegation and structural security plus proven patterns and a 90-day roadmap.
